source_of_truth: Velociraptor server client, flow, and result state
retirement_status: The workflow, monitor, analysis-plan, analysis-read, manager-handoff, range-read, and model-generated JSON paths are retired from host analysis.

triage.purpose: Smallest lead-finding and current-state host review
triage.windows: collection-type triage contains the default DetectRaptor baseline plus PublicIP and excludes opt-in YaraWebshell collection; detectraptor retains the exact 12-artifact bundle; evtx and mft are independently selectable subsets; network remains a separate live Netstat/DNS cache scope
triage.linux: inventory-validated identity, users/groups, login, cron, and service capabilities with optional volatile state
triage.macos: explicit minimal artifacts selected from live inventory

standard.windows: one canonical all request covering triage, network, execution, persistence-expanded, and lateral-movement scopes
standard.linux: inventory-validated baseline with distro-aware packages and explicit optional gaps
standard.macos: explicit system, execution, persistence, network, and unified-log artifacts

deep.windows: standard plus explicit filesystem, registry, YARA, exfiltration, or volatile follow-ups
deep.linux: lead-driven persistence, execution, authentication, web-server, container, or filesystem focus
deep.macos: standard plus bounded unified-log, launch item, filesystem, quarantine, process, or network follow-ups

timeline.purpose: Adjacent activity around a known bounded interval
timeline.linux: inventory-validated bounded journal plus optional path-bounded file-mtime and auth lanes
timeline.macos: explicit time-bounded unified-log and filesystem artifacts
